Assassins are trained to eliminate their quarry rather than capture them, favoring stealth, precision, and overwhelming force to strike quickly and disappear without a trace. An Assassin adds **Melee, Ranged (Heavy), Skulduggery, and Stealth** to their Career Skills. If Assassin is their starting Specialization, they may choose two of these skills and gain 1 free rank in each. Assassins may approach their work with professional detachment, personal conviction, or even ritual, but most consider completing the assignment their highest priority.![](data:image/png;base64,)
